name: CeylonDrive
description: A Sri Lankan travel platform connecting visitors with private chauffeur services, airport transfers, tour guides, vehicles, and destination information.
features: Tour and transfer discovery, fleet and guide listings, journey enquiry, and an itinerary-planning interface.
note: Public pages expose PHP routes and load Bootstrap, jQuery, and Google Maps. Internal services and booking operations were not audited.

name: Black Soul
description: A distinctive streetwear and music storefront combining merchandise discovery with an artist-led brand experience.
features: Featured clothing collections, shopping navigation, music presentation, and brand storytelling.
note: Next.js assets and hosting headers are visible on the public deployment. Database, payment provider, and internal architecture are not claimed.

name: Vellora Fashion
description: A fashion and lifestyle storefront with a curated visual identity spanning apparel, beauty, accessories, and editorial content.
features: Collection discovery, catalog navigation, search entry, wishlist and shopping-bag interfaces.
note: The public site serves Next.js assets. Store administration, checkout, and payment processing were not tested.

name: Kasagala Young Buddhist Association
description: A community website for the Kasagala Young Buddhist Association, presenting its mission, charitable activities, programmes, and ways to participate.
features: Sinhala-led content, language choices, programme sections, membership entry points, and donation information.
note: React and Vite markers are present in the public bundle. This is a development preview; membership and donation workflows were not exercised.

name: Ceylon C Tours
description: A chauffeur and car-rental website presenting Sri Lankan travel services, a vehicle fleet, and a clear path to ride enquiries.
features: Fleet discovery, service information, tour navigation, and booking calls to action.
note: Next.js assets are visible on the Netlify preview. This is listed as development work, rather than a production booking service.

name: 3S 3D Engineering Service
description: A visual business website for architectural visualization and engineering services, built around project presentation and enquiry.
features: Architectural visualization, BIM and consultation service sections, a project gallery, and contact calls to action.
note: Next.js assets are visible in the public deployment. Architectural work, awards, and business claims belong to the showcased organization; they are not developer credentials.

name: Facebook Post Scheduler
description: A social media scheduling application in development, exploring a dashboard-led workflow for content planning and AI-assisted social tools.
features: A public product overview and dashboard entry, presenting scheduling, analytics, and AI feature concepts.
note: Next.js assets are visible. Automated posting, AI services, analytics accuracy, Meta approval, and advertised security controls were not verified.
